page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.p: irrogandi, gratiæ faciendæ, pecuniam publicam tractandi, plerosque magistratus alios creandi, imprimis Hovetmannos illos, de quibus dixi sæpè, Præfectos item territoriorum extra urbem designandi, Delectos edendi; qui in collegiis sedeant domi ac foris, Quæstorem, Ædilem Reip. æditUOS publicanos eligendi, legationes mittendi: denique hujus officii est, toti Reip. consulere, &c in eam curas suas intendere. Senatorium munus bienne est, ita comparatum ut quotannis media senatûs pars, [Senatûs voce Consules quoque comprehendo) cui duo anni in munere expleti sunt collegio decedat; decedentium loco totidem alii numero octono succedant, collegiumque compleant. Quorum designatio quomodo fiat, post exponam. In senatu consules dignitate, honore, authoritate antecedunt: suffragii vi ac jure senator consuli par, idemque par referendi potestate. Sed consulum nec inanis est nec inefficax auctoritas in dicendis sententiis: quorum jus est, per vices ternis mensibus eo ordine, quem sors dat, senatui præsidere:

page.notes: Line 2 of the running text reads "publicam tractandi" in print; line 13 "Ædilem Reip. ædituos" has the printed form "ædituos" (corrected to "æditUOS" here in error and should read "ædituos"). Long s throughout is rendered as plain s. The ct ligature in "tractandi" and the ligature in "dicendis" are transcribed as ordinary letters. Hyphen-free line ends are written whole. The bracket before "Senatûs" is printed as "[" and the closing ")" is printed as printed. No marginal notes, no page numbers beyond 208, no catchword: the final line "præsidere:" is text, not a catchword.
